verdict.rationale: Offline-first sync is a fair question for a backend-as-a-service with databases and realtime, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a local client cache, offline write queue, or automatic sync on reconnect. Realtime event subscriptions and a containerized local dev setup are adjacent features, not offline client sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build offline-capable clients whose local writes sync automatically on reconnect
